failurePolicy: Single-flight account epoch guards. Save failure retains rotated credentials in memory, reports session_save_failed and issues no further RPC. Opted-in SOCKET_RECOVERY_FRAME is available privately on every getSocketToken result/error, including syntactically valid but semantically unusable credentials. AuthSession archives decode/semantic failures against the original account/UUID/profile/main-token binding before rejection, requires a separate encrypted saver, disconnects without another RPC or replacing the old normal session, and zeros the buffer in finally. A direct private caller must similarly seal/acknowledge then zero the private frame in finally on success or failure. No permissive decoder, broad history, auto retry, OTP or generic auth recovery reuse.
liveStatusReportedByParent: Both explicit Android-profile accounts logged in and self-confirmed. One corrected APK2637 getDhConfig still returned404 INVALID_CONSTRUCTOR, proving app ID/profile change alone does not establish HTTP voice-call support.
